record.bible_text: Now it came to pass in the days<WH03117> of Ahasuerus<WH0325>, (this <FI>is<Fi> Ahasuerus<WH0325> which reigned<WH04427><WTH8802>, from India<WH01912> even unto Ethiopia<WH03568>, <FI>over<Fi> an hundred<WH03967> and seven<WH07651> and twenty<WH06242> provinces<WH04082>:)

<FI> Where were<Fi> white<WH02353>, green<WH03768>, and blue<WH08504>, <FI>hangings<Fi> , fastened<WH0270><WTH8803> with cords<WH02256> of fine linen<WH0948> and purple<WH0713> to silver<WH03701> rings<WH01550> and pillars<WH05982> of marble<WH08336>: the beds<WH04296> <FI>were of<Fi> gold<WH02091> and silver<WH03701>, upon a pavement<WH07531> of red<WH0923>, and blue<WH08504>, and white<WH01858>, and black<WH05508>, marble<WH08336>. <RF>blue, hangings: or, violet, etc<Rf> <RF>of red...: or, of porphyre, and marble and alabaster, and stone of blue colour<Rf>

And they gave <FI>them<Fi> drink<WH08248><WTH8687> in vessels<WH03627> of gold<WH02091>, (the vessels<WH03627> being diverse<WH08138><WTH8802> one from another<WH03627>,) and royal<WH04438> wine<WH03196> in abundance<WH07227>, according to the state<WH03027> of the king<WH04428>. <RF>royal...: Heb. wine of the kingdom<Rf> <RF>state: Heb. hand<Rf>

And the drinking<WH08360> <FI>was<Fi> according to the law<WH01881>; none did compel<WH0597><WTH8802>: for so the king<WH04428> had appointed<WH03245><WTH8765> to all the officers<WH07227> of his house<WH01004>, that they should do<WH06213><WTH8800> according to every man's<WH0376> pleasure<WH07522>.

Also Vashti<WH02060> the queen<WH04436> made<WH06213><WTH8804> a feast<WH04960> for the women<WH0802> <FI>in<Fi> the royal<WH04438> house<WH01004> which <FI>belonged<Fi> to king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325>.<CM>

On the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117>, when the heart<WH03820> of the king<WH04428> was merry<WH02896> with wine<WH03196>, he commanded<WH0559><WTH8804> Mehuman<WH04104>, Biztha<WH0968>, Harbona<WH02726>, Bigtha<WH0903>, and Abagtha<WH05>, Zethar<WH02242>, and Carcas<WH03752>, the seven<WH07651> chamberlains<WH05631> that served<WH08334><WTH8764> in the presence<WH06440> of Ahasuerus<WH0325> the king<WH04428>, <RF>chamberlains: or, eunuchs<Rf>

To bring<WH0935><WTH8687> Vashti<WH02060> the queen<WH04436> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428> with the crown<WH03804> royal<WH04438>, to shew<WH07200><WTH8687> the people<WH05971> and the princes<WH08269> her beauty<WH03308>: for she <FI>was<Fi> fair<WH02896> to look on<WH04758>. <RF>fair...: Heb. good of countenance<Rf>

But the queen<WH04436> Vashti<WH02060> refused<WH03985><WTH8762> to come<WH0935><WTH8800> at the king's<WH04428> commandment<WH01697> by<WH03027> <FI>his<Fi> chamberlains<WH05631>: therefore was the king<WH04428> very<WH03966> wroth<WH07107><WTH8799>, and his anger<WH02534> burned<WH01197><WTH8804> in him. <RF>by his...: Heb. which was by the hand of his eunuchs<Rf>

Then the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> to the wise men<WH02450>, which knew<WH03045><WTH8802> the times<WH06256>, (for so <FI>was<Fi> the king's<WH04428> manner<WH01697> toward<WH06440> all that knew<WH03045><WTH8802> law<WH01881> and judgment<WH01779>:

And the next<WH07138> unto him <FI>was<Fi> Carshena<WH03771>, Shethar<WH08369>, Admatha<WH0133>, Tarshish<WH08659>, Meres<WH04825>, Marsena<WH04826>, <FI>and<Fi> Memucan<WH04462>, the seven<WH07651> princes<WH08269> of Persia<WH06539> and Media<WH04074>, which saw<WH07200><WTH8802> the king's<WH04428> face<WH06440>, <FI>and<Fi> which sat<WH03427><WTH8802> the first<WH07223> in the kingdom<WH04438>;)

What shall we do<WH06213><WTH8800> unto the queen<WH04436> Vashti<WH02060> according to law<WH01881>, because she hath not performed<WH06213><WTH8804> the commandment<WH03982> of the king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325> by<WH03027> the chamberlains<WH05631>? <RF>What...: Heb. What to do<Rf>

And Memucan<WH04462> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428> and the princes<WH08269>, Vashti<WH02060> the queen<WH04436> hath not done wrong<WH05753><WTH8804> to the king<WH04428> only, but also to all the princes<WH08269>, and to all the people<WH05971> that <FI>are<Fi> in all the provinces<WH04082> of the king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325>.

For <FI>this<Fi> deed<WH01697> of the queen<WH04436> shall come abroad<WH03318><WTH8799> unto all women<WH0802>, so that they shall despise<WH0959><WTH8687> their husbands<WH01167> in their eyes<WH05869>, when it shall be reported<WH0559><WTH8800>, The king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325> commanded<WH0559><WTH8804> Vashti<WH02060> the queen<WH04436> to be brought in<WH0935><WTH8687> before<WH06440> him, but she came<WH0935><WTH8804> not.

<FI> Likewise<Fi> shall the ladies<WH08282> of Persia<WH06539> and Media<WH04074> say<WH0559><WTH8799> this day<WH03117> unto all the king's<WH04428> princes<WH08269>, which have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> of the deed<WH01697> of the queen<WH04436>. Thus <FI>shall there arise<Fi> too much<WH01767> contempt<WH0963> and wrath<WH07110>.

If it please<WH02895><WTH8804> the king<WH04428>, let there go<WH03318><WTH8799> a royal<WH04438> commandment<WH01697> from him<WH06440>, and let it be written<WH03789><WTH8735> among the laws<WH01881> of the Persians<WH06539> and the Medes<WH04074>, that it be not altered<WH05674><WTH8799>, That Vashti<WH02060> come<WH0935><WTH8799> no more before<WH06440> king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325>; and let the king<WH04428> give<WH05414><WTH8799> her royal estate<WH04438> unto another<WH07468> that is better<WH02896> than she. <RF>If it...: Heb. If it be good with the king<Rf> <RF>unto...: Heb. unto her companion<Rf> <RF>from him: Heb. from before him<Rf> <RF>be not...: Heb. pass not away<Rf>

And when the king's<WH04428> decree<WH06599> which he shall make<WH06213><WTH8799> shall be published<WH08085><WTH8738> throughout all his empire<WH04438>, (for it is great<WH07227>,) all the wives<WH0802> shall give<WH05414><WTH8799> to their husbands<WH01167> honour<WH03366>, both to great<WH01419> and small<WH06996>.

And the saying<WH01697> pleased<WH03190><WTH8799><WH05869> the king<WH04428> and the princes<WH08269>; and the king<WH04428> did<WH06213><WTH8799> according to the word<WH01697> of Memucan<WH04462>: <RF>pleased...: Heb. was good in the eyes of the king<Rf>

For he sent<WH07971><WTH8799> letters<WH05612> into all the king's<WH04428> provinces<WH04082>, into every province<WH04082> according to the writing<WH03791> thereof, and to every people<WH05971> after their language<WH03956>, that every man<WH0376> should bear rule<WH08323><WTH8802> in his own house<WH01004>, and that <FI>it<Fi> should be published<WH01696><WTH8764> according to the language<WH03956> of every people<WH05971>. <RF>that it...: Heb. that one should publish it according to the language of his people<Rf><CM>
